name: northstar
description: Shortcut scripts for running the NorthStar backend (FastAPI) and frontend (Vite). Windows / cmd syntax. Backend and migrations target the isolated database (127.0.0.1:5433) via scripts/with_isolated_db.py without editing .env.

scripts.setup: npm run setup:backend && npm run setup:frontend
scripts.dev: start "NorthStar backend" npm run backend && npm run frontend
